messages.author: nency_patel
messages.content:
Hello Team,

I hope you are doing well. I am reaching out here regarding an issue I faced while completing my ViBe platform course before the deadline. Despite my sincere efforts to complete the course on time, I encountered several technical problems that were not caused by my actions.

While completing the course, I experienced these issues:

• After submitting quizzes, I received a score of 0 even though all answers were marked correct, which forced me to rewatch videos repeatedly.
• Even with a 100% quiz score, I was redirected back to the previous video, creating a continuous loop and blocking normal progression.
• After finishing the course, my progress showed around 99.60% instead of 100%. Upon manual checking, two videos were not marked as “watched” even though I had completed them — otherwise I would not have been able to proceed. After completing them again, the progress showed around 99.90% (dashboard showing 100%), but the deadline had already passed, which resulted in a –10% HP penalty.

Before contacting support, I followed the proper query process — I checked the FAQ, used the AI assistant ViSakha, and reviewed the broadcast Telegram channel. Since the issue remained unresolved and ViSakha advised me to contact the main support team, I raised this concern.

During the same period, I was also managing academic responsibilities, including organizing a segment of the Xenesis tech event at LDRP Institute of Technology and Research along with ongoing mid-examination submissions. Despite this, I made every effort to complete the course, and I believe the delay occurred due to platform glitches rather than negligence from my side.

I kindly request a review of my course progress and reconsideration/restoration of the –10% HP, as it is currently affecting my progress. I have screenshots and proof of the issues and can share them if needed.

Name: PATEL NENCY DASHARATHBHAI
Cohort Name: Euclideans
